given_when_then.given: A Delivery Partner is logged in and viewing their dashboard
given_when_then.when: The Order Allocation Engine assigns a new delivery task within their service zone
given_when_then.then: The system displays the delivery slot details including route, estimated arrival time, and item list for the partner to accept or reject

given_when_then.given: A Delivery Partner has reached their maximum workload capacity
given_when_then.when: The Order Allocation Engine attempts to assign a new delivery task to that partner
given_when_then.then: The system rejects the assignment and routes the task to another available agent within the same service zone

given_when_then.given: An agent has explicitly rejected a delivery assignment
given_when_then.when: The system processes the rejection request
given_when_then.then: The delivery task is dynamically reassigned to another available agent within the same service zone

given_when_then.given: Traffic patterns change significantly after the initial assignment
given_when_then.when: The system detects the traffic change
given_when_then.then: The system recalculates the estimated arrival time for the assigned delivery task

given_when_then.given: An agent accepts a delivery assignment
given_when_then.when: The system receives the acceptance confirmation
given_when_then.then: The system updates the agent's workload status in real-time and confirms the slot as active

success_criteria: The agent's workload status is updated in real-time immediately upon acceptance or rejection of a delivery task.
The system prevents assignment to an agent if their current workload exceeds the maximum capacity for their service zone.
The system confirms a delivery slot as active only after the agent explicitly accepts the assignment.
The system successfully reassigns a delivery task when the original agent rejects it or exceeds capacity limits.
The system recalculates estimated arrival times when significant changes in traffic patterns are detected.
The system does not assign a delivery slot to an agent who has exceeded their maximum capacity.
The system rejects a new assignment when an agent's current workload is at the maximum limit defined for their service zone.
The system routes the task to another available agent within the same service zone when the original agent rejects it.
The system updates the workload status and confirms the slot as active upon explicit acceptance of a delivery assignment.
The system displays delivery slot details including route, estimated arrival time, and item list for the partner to accept or reject.
